description: Every field a call to loom may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

colors.description: code (colours in code for light and dark, the default) or assets (read colors/background, colors/foreground and the other roles from the asset catalog)

features.description: the parts to write, every one when left out: vote, save, share, reply, report, block, nsfwShield, markdown, linkPreview, media, swipeActions, editing

imports.description: modules the conformances import, such as the package a mapped type is declared in

into.description: the folder for the views, relative to the project; Shared/Views/Social when left out

mappings.description: one line a role (post, comment, user, community, instance): `post: Dish title=name author=cook.name avatar=cook.photo score=likes comments=replyCount created=sharedAt`; a bare path is read off the value, anything else is Swift that may name `value`

prefix.description: a prefix for the view types when the app already has views of these names: `Kit` writes KitPostCardView

screens.description: the screens to write, every one when left out: feed, post, thread, compose, reply, profile, community, search, instances, filter, share

style.description: loom (Loom's look, the default), social (a timeline) or reader (compact rows with thumbnails and scores); all three are written, this is the one the views start in

title: What loom takes (craft-agent/1)
